SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
IN REGISTRY
SECTION 2
Date September 24, 1932

Subject (in full) Letter from Melchers & Co re: M. Genkin and G. Genkin.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by O.B. Ku. D.I.

With reference to the letter dated August 31, 1932, from
Melchers & Co on the subject of M. Genkin and G. Genkin, alleged
"to be connected with the Soviet activities", I have to state
that these individuals arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on Janu-
ary 15, 1932, by the s.s. "Choshun Maru".
Brothers Genkin are Russians of Jewish origin. They are
not known to any of the local Russian emigrants organizations,
but are registered as emigrants with the Public Safety Bureau
where they gave the following particulars:-
1). Mihail Yakovlevitch Genkin, born 1893, at Tomsk, merchant;
2). Gregory Yakovlevitch Genkin, born 1899, at Tomsk, merchant.
It is reported that they arrived in Harbin from the
U.S.S.R. during the earlier part of 1931 and that formerly M. Gen-
kin held a post in the Supplies Department of the Leningrad muni-
cipality. This, coupled with the fact that they were able to leave
Soviet Russia apparently, in possession of some funds, lead to
rumours of their being connected with Soviet activities, but, so
far, there is no evidence forthcoming to substantiate the alle-
gations against these two individuals.
Following their arrival here they resided at 321 Rue Car-
dinal Mercier until July 1-st, when they removed to 113 Route
Pere Robert, their present address.
In view of the foregoing, I would suggest that Messrs Mel-
chers & Co. be verbally informed that we are unable to confirm
the information they seek.

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

“A”
Yes H.G.
16/9
Officer i/c Special Branch.
Concurring in D.S. Prokofiev's suggestions
at “A”
J.P. Simone
O. i/c Sp.

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号
登记处
第 2 科
日期：1932年9月24日

事由（全称）：美最时洋行关于 M. Genkin 和 G. Genkin 的来信。

由 D.S. Prokofiev 拟稿，经 O.B. Ku 转呈，D.I. 阅。

关于美最时洋行于1932年8月31日就 M. Genkin 和 G. Genkin 一事所发信函，信中称二人“涉嫌与苏联活动有关”，本人谨陈述如下：上述人员于1932年1月15日乘“长顺丸”号轮船（s.s. "Choshun Maru"）从哈尔滨抵达上海。
Genkin 兄弟系犹太裔俄罗斯人。本地任何俄罗斯侨民组织均不知晓此二人，但他们在公安局作为侨民进行了登记，并提供了以下详细信息：
1). Mihail Yakovlevitch Genkin，1893年生于托木斯克，商人；
2). Gregory Yakovlevitch Genkin，1899年生于托木斯克，商人。
据报，他们于1931年初从苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟抵达哈尔滨，且 M. Genkin 此前曾在列宁格勒市政当局的供应部门任职。加之他们显然在拥有一定资金的情况下得以离开苏俄，导致有关于他们与苏联活动有关的谣言流传，但截至目前，尚无证据证实针对这两人的指控。
二人抵沪后，居住于西爱咸斯路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）321号，直至7月1日搬至贝当路（Route Pere Robert）113号，即其现住址。
鉴于上述情况，建议口头告知美最时洋行先生们，我方无法确认其所寻求的信息。

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

“A”
同意 H.G.
9月16日
特别处主管警官。
同意 D.S. Prokofiev 在“A”处的建议
J.P. Simone
特别处主管

Private Office.
August 31st 1931.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Intelligence Bureau,
Present.

Dear Sir,
Re: M. Genkin & G. Genkin,
residing at 113. Route Pere Robert

The above gentlemen, said to be Russian emigrants
from Petrograd, recently approached us in respect of a business
deal in connection with our refrigerator department. The deal may
require the extension of credit over some period.

In the absence of written references from above party
we beg to enquire whether the Intelligence Bureau of the S.M.P.
is in possession of any records in respect of the character of
said people.

（手写批注：a / 31/8）
Inofficial information, confidentially given to us,
hints at above party being connected with Soviet activities. Said
information, it is stated, emanated from Police quarters, and we
shall be much obliged to learn, either verbally or in writing,
whether any facts are known to substantiate such rumour.

Thanking you in anticipation for the courtesy of an
early confirmation of our enquiry,

We are, Dear Sir,
Yours faithfully,
（签名）

事由：M. Genkin 和 G. Genkin，
现居贝当路（Route Pere Robert）113号

上述绅士自称是来自彼得格勒的俄罗斯侨民，近期因涉及我行冰箱部门的商业交易事宜与我行接洽。该交易可能需要给予一定期限的信贷延期。

由于缺乏上述当事人的书面推荐信，敝行特此垂询，上海公共租界工部局警务处情报处是否掌握有关上述人员品行的任何记录。

（手写批注：a / 8月31日）
非正式地秘密提供给我们的消息暗示，上述当事人与苏联活动有关。据说该消息源自警方内部，若能以口头或书面形式获悉是否有事实可证实此类谣言，敝行将不胜感激。

提前感谢贵处对敝行查询的早日回复之礼遇，

此致
敬礼，
（签名）
